name: Hive Portfolio
author: menobass
description: Track the balances, Hive Power, voting power and resource credits of any number of Hive accounts from the bar. A tiny avatar rotates through your accounts, flags unclaimed rewards, and pulses (with an optional desktop notification) when voting power is full and mana is being wasted.

barWidget.description: Rotating Hive avatar with voting power in the bar; click for balances, VP, RC and settings.
